hints.always_use_relay: Force every connection through the relay.
hints.must_login: Only signed-in clients may connect (needs the same JWT key as the panel).
hints.tcp_keepalive: Keeps clients with "Use WebSocket" or in TCP mode (UDP blocked, proxy) shown online: hbbs pings them every 12 s. Off = upstream behaviour (such clients look online only ~30 s of every 90 s).
hints.webrtc: Forwards WebRTC offers, answers and ICE candidates between RustDesk 1.5+ clients that have "Enable WebRTC" on, so they can connect peer-to-peer over ICE (or through your TURN server). Off = upstream behaviour (WebRTC is not offered).
hints.blacklist: One IP or CIDR per line; relays from these IPs are slowed down.
hints.blocklist: One IP or CIDR per line; connections from these IPs are refused.
hints.limit_speed_mbps: Speed for blacklisted or downgraded relays.
hints.total_bandwidth_mbps: Global cap for all relayed traffic.
hints.downgrade_threshold: Ratio that marks a relay as heavy (e.g. 0.66).
hints.downgrade_start_check_s: Seconds before heavy relays are downgraded.
hints.relay_servers_computed: Computed from Server → Relays (healthy relays, repeated by weight). Edit relays there.
